verdicts.review_notes: Tried to break: years and months of found/gain/dissolve against both pages (all match); mirrors in dutch-ceylon (1796-02 dissolve to british-ceylon) and kingdom-of-kandy (1815-02 dissolve to british-ceylon) match within a month; certainty 1796-1814 + 1815-1948 is contiguous; the Ceylon/British Ceylon Wikidata split is argued in notes; the new keyframe has from, to and correction. Not a fault: the Uva Rebellion war (1817-1818) has a zone but no contest events (the brief only requires contest events to sit in a war zone); the notes say a sri-lanka dossier exists, which it does not yet (sa-06 parallel part, an allowed exception).

fixes.what: The princely state has no vassal relation to Britain at all, although three dossiers record it as their vassal and the dossier's own pages state it.
fixes.why: Treaty of Amritsar page, Article 10: 'Maharajah Gulab Singh acknowledges the supremacy of the British Government'; Jammu and Kashmir (princely state) page: 'in a subsidiary alliance with the British East India Company from 1846 to 1858' and British paramountcy 'from 1858 until British withdrawal and the partition of British India in 1947', infobox 'End of British Crown Suzerainty: 15 August 1947'. Mirrors with no counterpart here: british-empire /ledger/68 (1846 vassal_start kashmir-and-jammu) and /ledger/103 (1858-11 vassal_end); east-india-company /ledger/66 and /ledger/98 (same); british-raj /ledger/3 (1858-11 vassal_start kashmir-and-jammu) and /ledger/25 (1947-08 vassal_end), both in this same batch.
fixes.fix: Add vassal_start british-empire 1846-03 (Treaty of Amritsar, Art. 10, confidence 3), vassal_end british-empire 1858-11, vassal_start british-raj 1858-11 and vassal_end british-raj 1947-08 (princely state page), region {cliopatria: Kashmir and Jammu, year 1846 or 1947} as in the found event and the Raj's events. If the orchestrator rules east-india-company rather than british-empire as the 1846-1858 overlord, use that slug.
